en.summary: GTA VI is an upcoming Open world action game for PS5, Xbox, developed by Rockstar Games. It is scheduled to release on November 19, 2026.

guideSections.title: Platforms & release status
guideSections.description: GTA VI is confirmed for PS5, Xbox. The current release target is November 19, 2026, though release dates for smaller studios can still shift. Check the official links below for the latest word directly from the developer.
